# netpaytool.com
> Free take-home pay calculator. See your net pay after federal, state and FICA taxes, on 2026 tax law.

## What this tool does
- Calculates annual and per-pay-period net pay for a US salary, for single, married filing jointly and head of household filers
- Covers all 50 states plus DC
- Applies the 2026 federal income tax brackets (10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37%) after the standard deduction
- Includes FICA: Social Security 6.2% up to the $184,500 wage base, Medicare 1.45%, and the 0.9% additional Medicare tax over $200,000 (single) or $250,000 (married)
- Applies one effective income tax rate per state
- Shows effective and marginal tax rates

## Data sources
- Federal brackets and standard deduction: IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (tax year 2026)
- Social Security wage base: Social Security Administration announcement of October 24, 2025 ($184,500 for 2026)
- State income tax: Tax Foundation, "2026 State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets". Each state is reduced to a single effective rate, measured at $100,000 of single-filer taxable income, so results for states with graduated brackets are estimates
- Not modeled: local city and county income taxes in the net pay result, pre-tax deductions such as 401(k) and health insurance, and W-4 withholding choices

## Key facts (computed by this calculator, single filer)
- $75,000 salary in California: about $54,600 a year after tax
- $75,000 salary in Texas, which has no state income tax: about $61,600 a year after tax
- 2026 standard deduction: $16,100 single, $32,200 married filing jointly, $24,150 head of household
- Social Security tax stops at $184,500 of wages; Medicare tax applies to all wages

## Page types
- Salary and state pages: https://netpaytool.com/{salary}/{state-code} (20 salary levels from $30,000 to $300,000, for each state and DC; example /75000/ca)
- City pages: https://netpaytool.com/city/{slug} for 10 cities that levy a local income tax, showing the local rate (example /city/columbus-oh)
- Methodology: https://netpaytool.com/methodology

## Not supported
The calculator does not accept URL parameters. Link to the page for the salary and state you mean.

## Tool URL
https://netpaytool.com
